Possible paper issues, not changed: Q33 stem reads 'determines the that the number of weeks'; Q33(c) solution says 'days' while the model is in weeks; Q17(c) solution writes 42431 in the first line but the question says 42 432 (the working uses 84864 = 2 x 42432).
